channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.description: Multiple social media accounts were shut down after prominent members of Governor Ron DeSantis' communications team claimed that Layla Collins, wife of Lieutenant Governor Jay Collins, had been operating them to attack the Governor and promote her husband's campaign for the Republican gubernatorial

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% to $73.82 for meal for 10, with ground beef and strawberries seeing biggest increases
item.description: A Fourth of July cookout for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce offers artist residency program and public tours of historic Crain Estate
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce is transforming the city into an artistic destination through its artist-in-residency program and public tours of the historic Crain Estate.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description: A fatal head-on collision claimed the life of a 40-year-old driver on State Road 710 in Martin County early Sunday morning. The crash occurred around 2 a.m. near the intersection of State Road 710, also known as Beeline Highway, and Southwest Silver Fox Lane, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation attracts international artists to Fort Pierce with residency program
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination with an artist-in-residency program that attracts artists from around the world and offers classes for children and adults.

item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council to vote on giving 7 acres to FDOT for Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange at Florida's Turnpike. Final approval is expected at an upcoming meeting.

item.title: St. Lucie County Marine Unit rescues two boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday, thanks to a quick response from the St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit and the life-saving decision to wear life jackets.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year as inflation pushes ground beef and strawberry prices higher
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey. Ground beef is up 5.5%, buns are up 7.7% and strawberries are up 12.4%.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes today for $3 million renovation to nearly double slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a year-long renovation project funded by a state grant and transportation impact fees. The $3 million project is expected to be complete by next Fourth of July. When finished, the dock will nearly double its capacity, expanding from 18 to 44 slips

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday because of a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Defending World Cup champion Argentina survives 3-2 scare from Cape Verde in extra time
item.description: Lionel Messi and Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 on Friday in a thrilling World Cup Round of 32 match that went to extra time before the reigning champions advanced to face Egypt.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state title after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football team finished last season with a 10-2 record and a district title, but a second-round playoff exit has motivated them to pursue a state championship during the 2026 fall season. item.title: St. Lucie Mets Snap Nine-Game Skid With Late Comeback Win Over Tarpons
item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets ended their nine-game losing streak Sunday afternoon with a late offensive surge, rallying past the Tampa Tarpons for a 10-5 win at Clover Park.

item.title: Byron Donalds extends fundraising dominance in Florida Governor's race with $90 million raised
item.description: U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds has raised $90 million for his gubernatorial campaign, with nearly $10 million in his campaign account and more than $76.2 million to his political committee.

item.title: U.S. soccer team faces Belgium in World Cup knockout round Monday with key player suspended
item.description: The United States men's national team takes the field Monday night against Belgium in the Round of 16 at Lumen Field in Seattle, playing without suspended forward Folarin Balogun.

item.title: President Trump dominates 250th anniversary celebrations as critics draw comparisons to monarchy
item.description: The 250th anniversary of America's independence kicked off with a campaign-style rally by President Donald Trump on the National Mall, as his actions lead to comparisons with King George III.

item.title: Americans mark 250 years of independence with tempered celebrations amid political discord
item.description: Across the United States, Americans are celebrating the country's 250th birthday by tuning out partisan conflict and focusing on personal concepts of resilience and community.

item.title: European welfare states face demographic pressure as World Cup visitors showcase generous vacation policies
item.description: European visitors to the United States for the World Cup benefit from at least four weeks of paid annual leave under European Union rules, but aging populations threaten the sustainability of social programs.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation preserves Crain Estate history and brings international artists to Fort Pierce
